items.title: PHP security vulnerabilities CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619 (PHP2Shell)
items.summary: Security flaws in PHP versions 5.4 through 8.5 involving out-of-memory corruption and stale global state allow unauthenticated remote code execution (RCE) across web configurations (PHP-FPM, Apache mod_php, php-cgi, FrankenPHP, LiteSpeed) and are actively exploited in the wild.
items.actionRequired: Upgrade immediately to PHP 8.5.12, 8.4.27, 8.3.36, or 8.2.35 (or apply source backports for 7.4–8.1) and restart all PHP worker processes.

items.title: Java4Shell Base64 Decoder Heap Overflow (CVE-2026-114938)
items.summary: A heap-based buffer overflow in OpenJDK's AVX-512 VBMI Base64 decoder intrinsic (versions 17.0.6+ through 27, plus Oracle Java SE 8u511b33-perf) enables unauthenticated remote code execution on x86-64 hosts in applications like Keycloak, Jira, Confluence, Jenkins, and Artifactory.
items.actionRequired: Update to patched JDK builds (17.0.21.1, 21.0.13.1, 25.0.5.1, 27.0.1.1, or 8u513) or apply the temporary JVM flag -XX:-UseBASE64Intrinsics and restart services.
